title: Trisomy 21: the cause of Down syndrome
summary: Gautier set up cell culture in Paris and found that people with Down syndrome carry a third copy of chromosome 21.
why: First chromosome abnormality linked to a human condition.

notes.problem: Contested credit story stated as fact; source: 'according to Gautier's account' and 'The Jerome Lejeune Foundation asserts... Lejeune, and not Gautier, identified the 47th chromosome'.

unsung.contribution: Found the extra chromosome 21 behind Down syndrome, using cell cultures she established.
unsung.recognition: Lejeune was first author of the 1959 paper and took credit; the Lejeune Foundation disputes her account.
